content.short: Yakindu is a free IDE for Solidity contracts with client implementations for Atom and Visual Studio Code via the Language Server Protocol.
content.description: Yakindu, developed by Andreas Mülder and others in 2018, is an IDE for Solidity with client implementations for Atom and Visual Studio Code, connected through Microsoft's Language Server Protocol. It integrates statechart tooling to access core language features such as global variables alongside statechart modeling, giving developers a unified view of Solidity code and statecharts. It also offers on-the-go suggestions and fixes to help spot and resolve bugs as you work.
content.meta: Yakindu is a free integrated development environment to build Solidity-based contracts. Discover Yakindu and other Web3 Developer Tools on Lancers Web3 Explorer.
